# cloudflare_workflows (Data Source)

Accepted Permissions

- `Workers Scripts Read`
- `Workers Scripts Write`
- `Workers Tail Read`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_workflows" "example_workflows" {
  account_id = "account_id"
  search = "x"
}
```
